name: Anika Sharma
psychographics: Organised chaos manager; thrives on structure but hates rigid schedules that don't match her body clock.
current_solutions: Instagram for shift swaps with colleagues; Deliveroo for late-night meals; MyFitnessPal to track energy levels.
frustration: Logged into the warehouse shift app at 03:30am to request a swap; the app timed out and logged her out, forcing her to message her supervisor on WhatsApp to fix it.
decision_style: Reads Reddit threads about warehouse work before trying new apps; switches to cheaper alternatives quickly if they glitch.
voice: Fast-paced and colloquial; sprinkles sentences with 'like', 'literally' and British slang 'mate', 'sorted'.
